item.title: Pipelines, methane and the new emissions playbook
item.description: To learn how integrated LDAR programs can help pipeline operators reduce emissions, maintain compliance, and strengthen asset integrity, explore TEAM’s emissions reduction ecosystem.

item.title: Woven Metal Products’ woven together program recognized for excellence in strategic communications with Gold MarCom Award
item.description: Woven Metal Products (WMP) was recently named a 2025 MarCom Awards Gold Winner for Strategic Communications / Corporate Social Responsibility for its community engagement program, Woven Together.

item.title: Woven Metal Products honored with AWS Excellence in Welding Award at FABTECH
item.description: At the FABTECH metal manufacturing conference, Woven Metal Products (WMP) was named the winner of the American Welding Society (AWS) Excellence in Welding Award in the Small Business Category.

item.title: Southern Energy Renewables announce $1.4B methanol and sustainable aviation fuel Facility in St. Charles Parish
item.description: The company is expected to create 120 direct new jobs with an average salary of $97,267, which is 5% above the average St. Charles Parish wage.

item.title: Shutdown and turnaround safety: Managing risk, communication and workforce complexity
item.description: As facilities continue to modernize their turnaround strategies, integrating these technologies alongside strong safety practices can help ensure that critical maintenance work is completed on schedule while keeping workers safe.

item.title: AMPP releases industry report highlighting corrosion, workforce and technology trends shaping pipeline integrity
item.description: The report draws on contributions from AMPP technical experts and industry partners, including specialists in engineering, inspection, and asset integrity.

item.title: IEA orders largest oil reserve release in history. What it means for U.S. refiners and Gulf Coast contractors.
item.description: The Iran war has shut down roughly 20 million bpd of global oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz. The IEA's record 400 million barrel release buys time. It does not solve the problem.

item.title: Cypress Creek acquires 2.5 GW solar project with 2.9 GWh energy storage in development in Arkansas from Swift Current Energy
item.description: The project will be developed and constructed in three phases, each consisting of approximately 815 MW of solar generation paired with 240 MW / 960 MWh of battery storage capacity. All phases are expected to be placed in service by 2029.

item.title: United States to release 172 million barrels of oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright announced a coordinated IEA release of 400M barrels of oil.

item.title: EMCOR Industrial Services wins business award
item.description: EMCOR Industrial Services was named 2025 Large Business of the Year by the Texas City–La Marque Chamber of Commerce, recognizing the company’s business achievements and strong commitment to community involvement.
